title: Serving lists
subtitle: The stores each list lets a delivery type's competed deliveries be bid to, and the types pointing at it.

access.deniedHint: Ask an administrator for the Serving lists grant.

failed: The serving lists could not be loaded.
empty: There are no serving lists yet.
readOnlyPointing: A delivery type is pointed at a list by an HQ script; this screen shows the pointing types read-only.

flag.noEnabledMemberHint: A competed delivery type points at this list, but no member is enabled: its deliveries record ServingListInactive and are not competed.
flag.deactivatedCompetedHint: A competed delivery type still points at this deactivated list: its deliveries record ServingListInactive and are not competed.
flag.emptyHint: No store is on this list yet.

detail.title: Serving list
detail.subtitle: The stores on this list, with their duty today, and the list's history.
detail.deactivatedNote: This list is deactivated: the deliveries of the types pointing at it are not competed. It still lists its members.

duty.noRosterHint: No roster holds today: a delivery type that checks duty never bids this store.

members.failed: The members could not be loaded.
members.empty: No store is on this list yet.
members.notFoundTitle: This serving list does not exist
members.notFoundHint: No serving list has the id <v>{{id}}</v>.
members.dutyReadOnly: Duty is read from the store's roster, which is edited elsewhere.

columns.dutyTooltip: Whether a callout opening now would bid the store, and today's hours

history.placeholder: The list's history is not shown yet.

addStores.title: Add stores to {{list}}
addStores.intro: Search by code, name or city and pick stores, or paste a column of codes. They are added in one go, enabled; one bad code refuses the whole batch.

search.label: Search stores
search.failed: The stores could not be searched.
search.more: Showing the first <v>{{n}}</v> stores: narrow the search to see others.
search.closedHint: This store is closed: it is never bid while it is closed.

paste.label: Paste codes
paste.hint: One per line, or separated by commas or spaces.
paste.result: Added to the basket: <v>{{added}}</v>. Already in it: <v>{{skipped}}</v>.

basket.title: Basket
basket.empty: The basket is empty. Pick stores or paste codes.

refusal.title: Nothing was added
refusal.unknownList: This serving list no longer exists.
refusal.alreadyMembers: These stores are already on the list:
refusal.noCodes: Name at least one store to add.
refusal.notGranted: You may not edit serving lists.
refusal.failed: The stores could not be added.

writes.failed: The change could not be saved.
writes.notGranted: You do not have the right to edit serving lists.
writes.refreshed: The screen was behind and has been refreshed.
writes.openBids: A bid already offered is never withdrawn: the change applies from the next callout.

refusal.unknownList: This serving list no longer exists.
refusal.notMember: This store is no longer on the list.
refusal.nameRequired: A serving list needs a name in English and in Arabic.
refusal.nameTooLong: A name is longer than 100 characters.
refusal.alreadyInState: This change has already been made.

create.title: New serving list
create.hint: A new list is active and has no members: add stores to it next.

deactivate.title: Deactivate serving list
deactivate.subject: Deactivate {{name}}?
deactivate.effect: No delivery is competed through a deactivated list. Its members stay, and it can be reactivated.
deactivate.competed: The deliveries of {{types}} will stop being competed; they go to their fallback store.
deactivate.noCompeted: No competed delivery type points at this list.

reactivate.title: Reactivate serving list
reactivate.subject: Reactivate {{name}}?
reactivate.effect: Its enabled members are bid again from the next callout.

member.disableEffect: The store keeps its place and its history on the list, but is not bid.
member.enableEffect: The store is bid again from the next callout.
member.removeEffect: The store is no longer bid from the next callout. The list's history keeps it.
